title: Hotter Mania
description: Mod updates savannas, deserts and badlands
body:
[![Modrinth](https://i.postimg.cc/Gmw8qbWg/Wi0g-G3J.png) ](https://modrinth.com/user/Gospi) [![Discord](https://i.postimg.cc/D00jjrX2/qe-YK6H3.png) ](https://discord.gg/xWzV3h7kBa) [![Curseforge](https://i.postimg.cc/dt7NG9Fs/gwr-Ub-OG.png) ](https://www.curseforge.com/members/gospi/projects)

This is a major HOT update, bringing two new biomes, creatures, and items to the game! Explore new and familiar locations, fight dangerous enemies, trade with a new race, and craft amazing items.

---

### **New Biomes:**

- Toxic Dunes
- Dry Steppe

### **New Mobs:**

- Saiga
- Ominous Crab
- Tau-Kaa
- Tau-Kaarid
- Vulture
- Ostrich
- Sandsworm
- Scorpion
- Sand Snake
- Fluffbug
- Lava Bat
- Hyena
- Slavak(in dev.)

### **New Ores and Materials:**

- Tin
- Topaz
- Sunstone
- Sulfur

### **New Items:**

- Tin Armor and Tools
- Bronze Armor and Tools
- Topaz(trim material)
- Honey Apple/Bread/Soup/Pie
- Music Disc
- Oasis Armor Trim
- Ostrich Feather
- Ostrich Feather Fan
- Feather Banner Pattern
- Sweaters (various colors): For stylish gameplay.
- Gilded Bundle
- Gold Book
- Staff of Sun Strike

### **New Plants:**

- Low/Common/Tall Burnt Grass
- Cotton
- Prickly Grass
- Tin Bells
- Amber Flowers
- Dry Grass
- Echinocactus

### **Potions and Effects:**

- Cooling
- Cactus Juice
- Sun Strike(In biomes with temperatures above 1)
- Sneezing

### **New Blocks:**

- Baobab, Palm, Cactus and Necroak woods
- Infernite
- Petrified Sands
- Ominous Sands

## **World Generation:**

### Features:

- Oasis
- Desert/Badlands Arch
- Desert/Badlands Spire 
- Big Acacia
- Sulfur Canyon

### Structures:

- Tau-Kaa Camp(In Toxic Dunes)
- Archeology Camp
- Mirage Pyramid

---

**TEXTURE CREATE ARTISTS: (Discord:fredleon), Gospi, RoUtEr X**
